capabilities: Set a node_size numeric property on notes
Override graph node weight with the property value
extras: README warns that a non-numeric node_size property causes unexpected behavior; visible size range is limited to roughly 6-100.
intentEvidence: Now Obsidian only increases the node weight if there are many notes referencing it.
motivation: The author was sad that the graph did not show the actual structure of notes, since size was tied only to backlink count.
problem: The graph view sizes nodes only by reference count, which poorly reflects structure, especially in young vaults.
summary: Graph utility that lets each note's node size in the graph view be set manually via a node_size property.
